t: You're at Connaught Hall, a fully catered hall of residence on Tavistock Square in Bloomsbury. It's owned by the University of London and houses full-time students from colleges such as King's, UCL, Queen Mary, the LSE and SOAS. The name comes from Prince Arthur, Duke of Connaught and Strathearn, the seventh child and third son of Queen Victoria and Prince Albert. He served as Governor General of Canada, and was the only British prince to hold that post.
